purpose: Minimal constants to reimplement AIComp Soccer free-ball + pitch in Bevy/Rust
il2cpp_metadata: encrypted — MelonLoader/Il2CppDumper not required for this dataset
units: meters, seconds; play on XZ; Y up

free_ball_slide.note: Use measured 5.95 from timeplots, not mu*g=3.43 from materials alone

goal.rule: End walls collide EXCEPT |z|<=6 goal mouths — ball passes through and terminates (no bounce). Upright posts are solid vertical capsules at (±40.2, ±6) with world radius 0.3 (parent scale 0.6 × local capsule 0.5); ball-center contact radius = post_r + ball_r ≈ 0.706. Geometry behind the goal line (nets) is ignored — scoring terminates the free-ball path.

post_bounce.note: Grazing endline-rail hits have tiny geometric vn; PhysX still scrapes the ball inward hard (timeplot_2026-07-21_12-59-35 ~t=8.63: (0,-28.8)->(-11.7,-16.0)). Floor |vn| to graze_vn_floor_frac*|v| and kill at least scrape_tangent_frac*|v| of tangential speed.

goal.post_evidence: level0 CapsuleCollider on LeftPost/RightPost; timeplot_2026-07-21_12-36-34 ~t=9.42 and 12-59-35 ~t=8.63 endline scrapes.

pitch_marks_soccer_get_float.note: Depth=goal axis (X), Width=sidelines (Z). Ball-center AABB remains x±39.5 z±24.7.

kick_airborne_candidates.note: Ground Coulomb slide ONLY while grounded. Airborne XZ coasts (TimePlot planar decay=0). Bounce e≈0.23 from landing vy ratio (material 0.4 too high). Hang scales with lift (~0.28s@0.5 → ~0.61s@1.0).

shot_frida.note: Sim uses warmup 0.30s + charge_time ~0.36-0.38s to reach shot_charge=1.0 (TimePlot 0→0.95 in ~0.665s incl warmup). maxChargeTime=2 and rate=0.1 are upstream fields; strength→m/s mapping vs TimePlot ~30 m/s kick still UNKNOWN.

kickoff_frida.note: Post-goal freeze→ball reset. TimePlot 17-37-34 DB17 measured ~4.88s. Frida kickoffDelaySeconds=1.0 is a different knob (not this pause).

stale_ball_frida.note: Wired: MatchWorld.tick_stale_ball — if ball moves <2.5m within 5s of Play, whistle resets kickoff to opposite team (no score).

stamina_frida.note: Equal stam → tackler wins + both dump; higher stam steals no dump (user 2026-07-22). Frida tackle 1.5s / sprint 1.0s delays not live.

stamina_timeplot.note: Continuous sprint+has segments. Discord instant-refill at 0 NOT seen.

prefab_evidence.note: 100≈accel, 8≈sprint already TimePlot-locked. No CharacterController. Interact gates possession.

player_candidates.note: Prefab: capsule body 0.762, BallHoldLocation Z=1.67, NavMesh stoppingDistance=1.25. Walk 7 / sprint 8 / accel 100. Interact-gated pickup. Equal-stam tackle: tackler wins + both dump.

bevy_impl_hints: Ball: Dynamic RigidBody, LockedAxes::ROTATION_LOCKED, sphere collider radius radius_world, friction/restitution as contacts above OR custom Coulomb slide force -accel*normalize(vel) while grounded
Walls: cuboid colliders on playable AABB sides; restitution 0.2; open goal mouths |z|<=6 at x=±39.5 do not collide
Posts optional: capsules at (±40.2, ±6) contact radius ~0.706; can omit for v1
No linear damping on rigidbody — deceleration is material/custom friction only
Players: kinematic simple movers; stamina 0..1 drain 34.5s / regen 20s (TimePlot DB14); angularSpeed 2500 locked (DB18 yaw; Forward.X is cos)
Kicks: TimePlot charge->horiz/lift (see kick_airborne_candidates); ground slide only when grounded; Y hang drives carry distance
